newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-KLAIRON DAVIS SUFFERS SURPRISE DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-KLAIRON DAVIS SUFFERS SURPRISE DEFEAT.

text.p: Arthur Moore-trained Cheltenham champion Klairon Davis suffered a surprise defeat in the McCain Limited Extended Handicap Chase at Leopardstown on Friday.
The 1996 Queen Mother Champion Chase winner set off the 4-5 favourite for the two-mile, two-furlong (3.5 kms) trip but succumbed to a surprise eight-defeat by Jim Dreaper's 5-4 chance Merry Gale.
The two ran together for much of the race but Merry Gale took advantage of a significant weight advantage to finish strongly and win comfortably.
